name: ratchet-loop
description: Ratchet Loop — a checkpoint-and-gate build loop for AI coding agents, working with any model provider: a single orchestrator splits a feature into small ordered checkpoints, and every checkpoint must pass four hard gates (behavior tests, UI review against a prototype, adversarial code review, human review) before the next one starts. Includes the checkpoint planner, test planner, prototype/design agents, isolated UI reviewers, adversary + fixer, a Stop hook that won't let the agent quit early, and a checkpoint viewer.
